lead: A `-p nvs-hir` fixture that tests a *configured* `MemberResolver` sees each diagnostic twice, and the first copy is not from the resolver under test.
body: `resolve_file` runs a member check of its own with `MemberResolver::new()`, into the same `Diagnostics` the fixture then hands to `check`, so an assertion over every `E0320` fails on the copy that resolver reported. Give `check` a fresh `Diagnostics` and assert over that one, as `free_function_helps` does.
